title: Names of adults
statement: Write a function `adultNames(people)` that takes an array of objects like `{ name: 'Asha', age: 31 }` and returns an array with only the names of people aged 18 or over, in the original order. If nobody qualifies, return an empty array.
fallbackHints: You are being asked to pick some items from a list and then report one detail about each. What are the two separate jobs?
Look at one person at a time. Each person is an object, so you read their details with dot notation. Decide first whether to include them, and only then think about what to store.
Check the boundary carefully: exactly 18 should be included. The result holds names only, not whole person objects, so be careful about what you add to your new array.
Make an empty array for the results, loop over the people, and when a person's age is at least 18 add just their name to the results. Return the results after the loop.
Use `const names = [];`, `for (const person of people)`, and `if (person.age >= 18) { names.push(person.name); }`. Then `return names;`.
